args.title: Bellwether Office Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Warehouse automation in 2026" highlights autonomous carts boosting pick rates, but integration taking longer than expected.
- Linked article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts; integration took roughly twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest operational saving came from a reduction in mis-picks.
